resumen: Sin gestión: lo que pedían queda fuera de mi cometido

eventos.texto: Good evening, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hello, I'm calling from Med Supply. We have great prices on gloves and masks. Could I speak to the manager?
Llamada comercial (1,00): declina sin leer datos de nadie
Thanks for calling, but this line is only for patients' appointments, so I can't take sales calls or pass on anyone's contact details. Is there anything else I can help with?
Sin gestión · lo que pedían queda fuera de mi cometido
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
